Free and open source. No account required.

Save your plan and come back later

Roadmaps saves your edits automatically in the browser. You can copy a direct link to the exact plan you're working on, bookmark it, and return without hunting through your library.

Copy a link to your editable plan

  1. Open your roadmap. Select the plan in the Roadmap selector.
  2. Choose Copy plan link. The editor displays a URL containing a plan identifier, such as ?plan=....
  3. Copy or bookmark it. Save it in your browser bookmarks, notes, calendar or task list.
  4. Return in the same browser. Open the link to go directly to that editable plan, provided the browser still holds your workspace.

Important: A saved-plan bookmark is not a cloud backup. It does not include the roadmap data. It will not retrieve your edits on a different browser or device, after clearing site data, or if you use a different site origin.

Find a plan in your library

Choose Roadmap library in the sidebar. Plans are listed with their last-edited date, activity count, Open plan and Copy link actions. You can also switch between plans using the dropdown at the top of the editor.

Keep a backup

Open Data backup and export the whole workspace as Markdown or CSV. It includes your roadmaps, history, templates and local notes. Store this file somewhere safe. To restore, select the file and choose whether to add its content or replace your workspace.

Move to another device

Export a workspace backup on the original device, open Mightora Roadmaps on the new device, then import it. Alternatively, share or publish a snapshot link and choose Save an editable copy on the receiving device; this creates a separate plan, not a live shared workspace.
